model: Each individual marker rasterized a CSS filter drop-shadow, and selection interpolated that filter for 200ms. The shadow is now a box-shadow, so pan and selection do not resample the marker bitmap through a filter.

noise.rule: 60 is one filtered marker times 60 frames. 12 is round(200ms * 60fps / 1000) for the marker whose shadow changes on selection. The live pan total is 60 times the visible individual marker count. Not a sampled compositor trace.
